description: This file contains Python functions related to RISC-V build payloads, specifically generating extra image and device tree file paths based on build variables, and determining dependencies based on payload variables.

methods.name: riscv_get_extra_oemake_image
methods.description: Generates the path to the SBI payload image based on build variables.

methods.name: riscv_get_extra_oemake_fdt
methods.description: Generates the path to the SBI FDT based on build variables.

methods.name: riscv_get_do_compile_depends
methods.description: Determines the build dependencies based on the presence and content of RISCV_SBI_PAYLOAD and RISCV_SBI_FDT variables.
